verdict.rationale: Alloy's docs state that workflows can run 'on a schedule as a Portfolio workflow' and that transaction monitoring can run 'at scheduled times'. That is first-party evidence of scheduled workflow execution, but the evidence is two brief mentions with no detail on how schedules are set up or managed. missing for 10: documentation of how to configure recurring schedules (cadence, timing, API or UI controls), explicit confirmation of recurring rather than one-off scheduling, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows

citations.quote: Workflows can run in real time as part of a Journey evaluating an incoming application, or on a schedule as a Portfolio workflow
Monitors transaction events in real time or at scheduled times to detect suspicious activity
